legend.text: A thicker line is a higher shared-interest score

spotlight.heading: Ana ↔ Jo, on Tue / Thu 4:30pm
detail: Ana and Jo share two interest tags — robotics and Python — and are the only pair on this graph scoring above 1. That is why their line is the thick one.

Tue / Thu 4:30pm is the only candidate that passes mentor availability, venue hours, and the holiday calendar together. Monday excludes Ana; Wednesday hits a venue closing time that has nothing to do with people at all.

Three of the five students tie at score 1, and two of them depend on a single mentor each. A ranking hands a person a shortlist; it does not hand them a decision, and the pairings it is least sure about are the ones worth a human look.
